name: EPIC 247613360
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 7.4 solar radii and 1.56 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,122 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.56 solar masses and 7.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,007 K at its surface.
